item.title: Tort claim alleges WA DOL left your information open to criminals

item.description: A new sales tax in Pierce County aims to strengthen public safety and the criminal justice system. Pierce County Executive Ryan Mello signed the Justice Fund into law on Thursday.

item.title: Tips sought in February homicide of Port Angeles, WA man
